title: Luke 21:29-33
subtitle: Friday of the 34th Week in Ordinary Time · Rv 20:1-4, 11–21:2; Lk 21:29-33
text: Jesus tells his disciples to watch the fig tree: when its buds burst open, summer is near. Heaven and earth will pass away, but his words will not. With Advent beginning Sunday, read one page of the Gospel today.
imageAlt: Engraving of Jesus standing beneath leafy trees and palms, one arm raised as he teaches a group of disciples gathered around him, some seated on the ground
credit: Moreau, The Parable of the Fig Tree (Luke 21:29), engraving in the Bowyer Bible, Bolton Museums and Archives. Photo by Phidev74, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
